result.summary: Found 1 minor visual inconsistency: the favorite-heart icon background is missing on one restaurant card.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card lacks the dark circular background used on the pizza card below, making the icon treatment inconsistent and slightly harder to distinguish against the food image.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same translucent dark circular background behind the heart icon on all restaurant image cards.
